work.summary: Designing and shipping robust backend services for client-facing products, with a focus on clean architecture, reliability, and performance.
highlights: Developed REST and event-driven APIs with Java and Spring Boot, improving request throughput and response times.
Integrated Kafka for asynchronous event pipelines and Redis for caching and session management.
Containerized services with Docker and automated deployments through CI/CD pipelines on AWS.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into scalable system designs.
